findings.title: Cleartext HTTP references
findings.remediation: Remove cleartext endpoints or document an approved exception; enforce HTTPS and verify Network Security Config.

findings.title: Hardcoded credential-like literals
findings.evidence: No credential-like assignment literal found by this heuristic.
findings.remediation: Move credentials to a secret manager/CI secret store and rotate any exposed credential. Review heuristic results manually.

findings.title: Sensitive token persistence review
findings.evidence: app/src/main/java/com/example/data/GoogleAuthManager.kt:3: import android.content.SharedPreferences; app/src/main/java/com/example/data/GoogleAuthManager.kt:15: class GoogleAuthManager(private val sharedPrefs: SharedPreferences) {; app/src/main/java/com/example/data/GoogleAuthManager.kt:22: val accessToken = sharedPrefs.getString(KEY_ACCESS_TOKEN, null); app/src/main/java/com/example/data/GoogleAuthManager.kt:23: val refreshToken = sharedPrefs.getString(KEY_REFRESH_TOKEN, null); app/src/main/java/com/example/data/GoogleAuthManager.kt:44: putString(KEY_ACCESS_TOKEN, accessToken); app/src/main/java/com/example/data/GoogleAuthManager.kt:45: if (refreshToken != null) putString(KEY_REFRESH_TOKEN, refreshToken) else remove(KEY_REFRESH_TOKEN); app/src/main/java/com/example/data/GoogleAuthManager.kt:67: sharedPrefs.edit().remove(KEY_ACCESS_TOKEN).remove(KEY_REFRESH_TOKEN); app/src/main/java/com/example/data/GoogleAuthManager.kt:71: fun getAccessToken(): String? = sharedPrefs.getString(KEY_ACCESS_TOKEN, null)
findings.remediation: Confirm that refresh tokens are encrypted with a Keystore-backed design, access tokens are short-lived, and backup exclusion is tested.

findings.title: Cryptographic key fallback review
findings.evidence: app/src/main/java/com/example/security/KeystoreVaultManager.kt:23: private var fallbackKey: SecretKey? = null; app/src/main/java/com/example/security/KeystoreVaultManager.kt:51: if (fallbackKey == null) {; app/src/main/java/com/example/security/KeystoreVaultManager.kt:53: val keyGen = KeyGenerator.getInstance("AES"); app/src/main/java/com/example/security/KeystoreVaultManager.kt:55: fallbackKey = keyGen.generateKey(); app/src/main/java/com/example/security/KeystoreVaultManager.kt:73: return fallbackKey ?: throw IllegalStateException("No valid SecretKey available")
findings.remediation: Do not silently use an ephemeral key for durable vault data; fail closed or implement a documented, durable key-wrapping/recovery design.

findings.title: Backup and restore rules
findings.evidence: Manifest allowBackup/dataExtractionRules present=True; explicit exclude rule=True.
findings.remediation: Define explicit per-domain backup/transfer policy for vault files, tokens, database, cache, and keys; test restore and device transfer.

findings.title: Exported component review
findings.evidence: Manifest exported declarations=['true', 'false']; launcher activity exported=True.
findings.remediation: Keep only intentionally public components exported and validate all incoming intents/URI data. Verify merged manifest and runtime behavior.

findings.title: Storage/media permission review
findings.evidence: app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:5: <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE" android:maxSdkVersion="32" />; app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:6: <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE" android:maxSdkVersion="29" tools:ignore="ScopedStorage" />; app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:7: <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES" />; app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:8: <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO" />; app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:9: <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO" />
findings.remediation: Request the narrowest permission at runtime for each API level, support scoped/partial media access, and test denial/revocation paths.

findings.title: Release shrinking/obfuscation configuration
findings.remediation: Verify release-only R8/shrinking configuration, keep rules, mapping retention, and a signed release artifact. Do not disable R8 to bypass failures.

findings.title: Local credentials/signing material in repository
findings.evidence: No local.properties/keystore/JKS file found in extracted tree.
findings.remediation: Keep signing credentials and local SDK configuration outside source control; rotate anything ever committed and scan full Git history.

findings.title: Automated test inventory
findings.remediation: Add tests for auth expiry, backup/restore, Keystore invalidation, permissions, worker idempotency, crash recovery, and destructive operations.

findings.title: Reproducible Gradle wrapper
findings.remediation: Use the repository wrapper in CI and document pinned JDK/SDK/build-tools versions.
